description:
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Invert // Invent, Walk the Aeons, and any number of cards with different mana costs to your hand and putting Seasons Past on the bottom of your library.
Cast Invent by paying {4}{U}{R}, putting Seasons Past from your library into your hand.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
Repeat each turn.
